description: Which engineering topics have curated briefings, how many links each has and the newest links across all of them. Each link comes with its source, source type and a two-line summary. Topics are public bookmark folders (CUDA, inference, RAG, agents…). Each item is a post someone saved, its main source, the source type and a two-line summary in English and Portuguese. `?resumo=1` returns only `total` and each topic's `slug` and `total`. 404 until the first publication.
